For Raymarine a/c/e/eS/gS Series Wi-Fi-enabled MFDs, this app can connect either directly to the MFD’s Wi-Fi network or through a Wi-Fi access point connected to the RayNet network.

For Axiom MFDs, this app requires a Wi-Fi access point connected to RayNet. Direct connection to the Axiom’s built-in Wi-Fi is not supported because the control port is not exposed on the MFD Wi-Fi interface.

SoftRMK is an unofficial independent project and is not made, endorsed, sponsored, approved, or supported by Raymarine.
SoftRMK is a local-network remote control app for compatible marine displays. The app does not require account creation and does not use advertising SDKs or analytics SDKs.

SoftRMK uses local network connectivity state, Wi-Fi interface state, multicast discovery traffic on the local network, compatible display identifiers and network endpoints discovered on the local network, the selected paired display identifier, and a sender identifier stored locally for pairing and control compatibility.

SoftRMK stores a small amount of app state locally on the device, including remembered paired target identifiers, remembered target names, remembered broker or network endpoints, a remembered sender MAC or generated fallback sender identifier, and whether the startup notice has already been shown. This information is stored locally in the app’s private storage on the device.

SoftRMK sends control and pairing messages over the local network to compatible displays or their associated local broker service. These messages may include key press, key repeat, rotary control, pairing confirmation, and sender identifier values required by the device protocol.

SoftRMK does not sell user data. It does not share user data with advertising providers, analytics providers, or unrelated third parties. Network traffic generated by the app is sent only as part of the app’s core functionality to compatible devices or services on the local network.
Locally stored app data remains on the device until the user clears app data, uninstalls the app, or the app overwrites older remembered values with newer ones.

SoftRMK stores app state in the app’s private Android sandbox. The app communicates over the local network as required by the target device protocol. Use trusted local networks and compatible equipment you control or are authorized to access.
SoftRMK is not designed for children.
This privacy policy may be updated as the app changes. The latest version should be published with the app source repository and the Google Play listing.
